item.title: Building Docker images with Nix: same inputs, same hash
item.description: Run docker build twice on the same Dockerfile, with no changes in between, and compare the results: 1 2 docker build -t app:v1 . && docker save app:v1 | sha256sum docker build -t app:v2 . && docker save app:v2 | sha256sum The two hashes won’t match. Nothing in your code changed, but the image did. I’ve been building images with Nix for a while, and it fixes exactly this.
